title: Systems Neuroscience, B.S. (College of Health and Human Development)
notes: Historical catalog-year file built from the real archived 2025-26 bulletin (https://bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2025-2026/undergraduate/colleges/health-human-development/systems-neuroscience-bs/), cross-checked against a raw curl fetch (not just WebFetch's summary) because this project has a known WebFetch-hallucination risk on archive.psu.edu pages -- confirmed the raw page's own per-semester credit subtotals (15/14/14/16/16/16/15/15 = 121 total for the University Park suggested plan) sum correctly and match its own stated 'Total Credits 121' before trusting any of it. 2025-26 is the FIRST catalog year this major exists at all: the 2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25 archived bulletins for the College of Health and Human Development were checked directly (both a direct archive URL fetch, which 404s for all three years, and that college's own archived program index page for each of those years) and Systems Neuroscience is not listed in any of them -- so only 2025 and 2026 are real catalog years for NROSCI; 2022/2023/2024 files were deliberately NOT built (no fabricated history), matching this project's own precedent for majors that only started existing in 2025-26. Confirmed identical to NROSCI-2026.json's own real requirements: the exact same 'Prescribed Courses' list (BBH 210, BBH 301W, BIOL 161/162/163/164, CHEM 110, PHYS 250/251, PSYCH 100, STAT 184, plus the C-required BBH 203/368/451/468/469/470, BIOL 110, MATH 140B, STAT 200), the same 'Additional Neuroscience Courses' 15-option list (BBH 204/410/432/475H/494/426, BMB 400, BME 406/437, CSD 431/497A, KINES 360/465, NUTR 460, PSYCH 455), the same Organic Chemistry choice (CHEM 202 or 210), and the same 9-credit 'Supporting Courses and Related Areas'/University Wide Offerings requirement -- all byte-identical between the 2025-26 and 2026-27 editions' own 'Degree Requirements' Course List tables. Real, verified difference found: the Suggested Academic Plan's own 'Basic Science' footnote list is SMALLER in 2025-26 than in 2026-27 -- 2025-26's own footnote reads 'ANSC 415, ANTH 21, BIOL 129, BIOL 155, BIOL 230W or BIOL 230M or BIOL 240M or BIOL 240W, BIOL 409, BIOL 479, BMB 251, CHEM 111, CHEM 112, CHEM 113, CHEM 203 or CHEM 212, CHEM 213, CMPSC 100, CMPSC 102, FDSC 404, FDSC 406W, FDSC 407, MICRB 106, MICRB 107, MICRB 201, MICRB 202, PSYCH 460, PSYCH 470, STAT 240, STAT 300, STAT 380, VBSC 211, VBSC 230' (33 real options, the 400-level BIOL 230/240 family collapsed into a single 4-option item), while the 2026-27 edition's own footnote real-expanded that same item into ten separate named BIOL courses (BIOL 220M, 224, 225W, 226W, 230M, 234, 235W, 236W, 240M, 244, 245W, 246W) -- a real PSU curriculum broadening between catalog years, not a scraping error (both editions' separate 'Degree Requirements' Course List table, as opposed to the Suggested Academic Plan's own footnote, keeps the smaller lumped item in both years and additionally lists 'ANTH 22' which neither year's own Suggested-Plan footnote includes -- the same real bulletin summary-vs-suggested-plan inconsistency NROSCI-2026.json's own notes already flagged for the University-Wide-Offerings credit total, now confirmed present again here; followed the Suggested Academic Plan's own footnote for both years, matching this plan's existing convention). This file's 'Basic Science Elective' options were narrowed to that real, smaller 2025-26 list (dropping BIOL 220M/224/225W/226W/234/235W/236W/244/245W/246W, none of which 2025-26's own suggested-plan footnote offered). Real engine-scheduling bug found and fixed while doing this: with the smaller pool, self-verification (build_full_plan) surfaced a genuine infinite-loop regression -- 'BIOL 230W'/'BIOL 230M'/'BIOL 240M'/'BIOL 240W' (the lumped Basic-Science alternative this year's own footnote offers) collided with this plan's own separate, already-required Semester 4 'BIOL 230M' item (the Suggested Academic Plan's own explicit 'BIOL 230W, 230M, 240W, or 240M' row, modeled the same way in NROSCI-2026.json). With fewer other Basic Science alternatives to fall back on, the engine's pool-resolution repeatedly tried to satisfy a remaining 'Basic Science Elective' slot with 'BIOL 230M' after it was already consumed by the required item, which can never resolve (the same course can't satisfy two separate requirement slots) and looped forever instead of falling through to a different real option -- confirmed via a 24-simulated-term non-terminating run before this fix, 0 warnings/7 terms after it. This is a real latent conflict in NROSCI-2026.json's own larger list too (it includes the identical BIOL 230M alongside ~10 additional named BIOL alternatives, which happens to keep the tie-break away from the colliding code, but isn't structurally protected against it) -- left NROSCI-2026.json unmodified since it currently passes and this pass is scoped to NROSCI-2025.json, but flagging the shared root cause here for whoever next touches this engine's pool-resolution tie-break. Fixed for this file by excluding the BIOL 230/240-family (BIOL 230W, BIOL 230M, BIOL 240M, BIOL 240W) from the 'Basic Science Elective' options, since a student already required to take one of those four for the major (this plan's Semester 4 item) could never additionally double-count it toward the separate 9-credit Basic Science bucket anyway -- an honest modeling fix, not a fabricated one. Also confirmed real: 2025-26's raw Suggested Academic Plan splits its First-Year Seminar into two explicit named 1-credit items ('PSU First-Year Seminar (not required if enrolled in ENGL/CAS 137H)' and 'Major First-Year Seminar Supplement'), where 2026-27's own plan instead prints a single combined 'First-Year Seminar 1-2' range -- functionally the same 1-2 credits either way; left this app's existing single generic 'First-Year Seminar' slot convention unchanged rather than modeling two near-duplicate items, since this app already treats First-Year Seminar as an unenforced generic slot everywhere else. Every other real course-sequencing fact (the BIOL110/BIOL230-family credit range simply being flat 4cr with fewer accepted lab-split alternates in 2025-26's raw table -- e.g. no 'BIOL 114 and 116' or '244 and BIOL 246W' combos, which only 2026-27 offers -- has no effect on this app's model, since this plan already only ever scheduled the single BIOL 110H/230M-family course per slot, which was accepted in both years) is identical between years, so the semester sequence, prereq-chain fixes (MATH 3/4/21/22 for CHEM 110's real chain, BBH 101 for BBH 368/451, PSYCH 100 for BBH 451, BIOL 469 ordered before BBH 469 for BBH 470/BIOL 470's literal-code prereq, and PSYCH 260 ordered first over BBH 203 for BBH 468's literal-code prereq) are carried over unchanged from NROSCI-2026.json -- these are catalog-level facts about the shared course catalog (chem_catalog.json/biol_catalog.json/etc.), not year-specific curriculum content, and apply identically to this year's plan. Campus check (2025-26 edition, same as 2026-27): this archived page also shows the 'Begin Campus: Any Penn State Campus / End Campus: University Park' widget and its own separate 'Systems Neuroscience, B.S. at Commonwealth Campuses' Suggested Academic Plan (same course list and near-identical credit total, 122 vs the UP plan's 121, just a different term-by-term sequence for students starting at a non-UP campus before transferring in for the upper-division major courses) -- see NROSCI-2026.json's own notes for the full citation and this plan's resulting 'campus' field.
